g.text: 1. UPPER APRON FRAME PLAN (TOP-DOWN VIEW AT Z = 27.0")
2. DETAIL A: "L-SHAPED" 2x4 CORNER LEG JOINT (ZERO PLANING NEEDED)
Glued in corner to mount 3/8"-16 leveling foot insert
Drilled on inside face of Piece B into
flat face of Piece A + Titebond II glue
WHY THE "L-SHAPED" 2x4 CORNER LEG DESIGN IS SUPERIOR:
• Zero Planer or Jointer Needed: Factory-flat edge of Piece B joins factory-flat face of Piece A.
• No Green Pressure-Treated 4x4s: Home Depot Canada only stocks green wet 4x4s outdoors. 2x4 studs are dry!
• Huge Torsional Rigidity: An L-bracket column has a 3.5" x 3.5" perimeter envelope that resists twist!
• Internal Corner Foot Pad: The glued 2x2 corner block gives a solid 1.5" thick base for threaded leveling glides.
3. COMPLETE 2x4 SPF LUMBER CUTTING SCHEDULE & BOARD BREAKDOWN
HOW TO CUT 7 STANDARD 8-FOOT (96") 2x4 STUDS WITH ZERO WOOD WASTE:
L-Leg Piece B: Side Return Flange (30.00")
CUT SIZE (T x W x L)
Upper long rails (2x) & lower long stretchers (2x) spanning front and rear
Upper side rails (2x) & lower side stretchers (2x) connecting front and rear legs
Upper & lower cross-ties between front and rear 38" rails; anchors center partition
Front face of the 4 L-shaped corner columns; 30.0" tall for 31.5" finished bench height
Side returns of the 4 L-shaped corner columns; pocket screwed to Front Flanges at 90°
Scrap 2x4 blocks glued inside bottom corner of each L-leg; bored for 3/8" leveling foot insert
TOTAL 2x4 SPF LUMBER NEEDED: Exactly 7 Standard 8-foot (96") Studs (~$45.50 CAD at Home Depot Canada SKU 1000112108)
